Title: Sending Out of the Twelve
DateApprox: c. AD 27-30 or AD 30-33 (approx., date debated)
KeyPersons: Jesus; Simon Peter; Andrew; James, Son of Zebedee; John the Apostle; Philip; Matthew; Thomas
Events: Jesus sends the twelve apostles out two by two to preach the kingdom, heal the sick, and cast out demons, giving them authority and instructions for the journey.
